item.title: Special Patterns
item.description: Some coffee systems exhibit unique or uncommon planting patterns that deviate from traditional configurations.

item.title: Terrain Artifacts
item.description: Coffee is often grown in mountainous environments, where slope and shadow effects can distort the visual appearance of coffee systems in high-resolution imagery. These artifacts may obscure planting patterns or create visual inconsistencies, highlighting the importance of careful interpretation.
